_comment: HAND-AUTHORED. Maps each of the 55 FD5-Shopping-List.html short row names (data/raw/shoppinglist.json rows[].name, domIndex 0-54) to the ingredient id(s) it buys. Values are always arrays: length 1 for a normal row, length 2 for the two verified shared-SKU rows (one shopping line, two logical ingredients: Greek yoghurt+skyr, and the discovered raspberries+blueberries case - both confirmed by the row's own note text). Three rows (Sweetheart cabbage, Frozen sliced peppers, Rapeseed oil) map to ids that do not exist in fd5.json and are created fresh in join.js (addedInExtraction: true) because PLAN.md/task brief confirms 'no ingredient anywhere' for these three. Every mapping below was hand-verified against data/raw/fd5.json spec[id][0] display names, data/raw/shoppinglist.json productString/note text, and (for the two known traps) the task brief's explicit trap list. ZERO fuzzy matches.
